svg.title: How Local Voice works
svg.desc: Apps call Android TextToSpeech; the Local Voice service segments text, renders ahead, emits rangeStart word marks and applies speed and pitch, then returns PCM. Speech comes from on-device models (Kokoro, Supertonic 3, Pocket TTS, Shtorm, Silero, NeuTTS Nano via sherpa-onnx and llama.cpp) by default, or Microsoft Edge online voices only when enabled. Models install from pinned files checked by size and SHA-256, then appear atomically.
